FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.

2. When practising Listening for understanding Identifying key points Vocabulary Attention, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for understanding Identifying key points Vocabulary Attention.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for understanding Identifying key points Vocabulary Attention.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for understanding Identifying key points Vocabulary Attention.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for understanding Identifying key points Vocabulary Attention.

3. When practising Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.

4. When practising Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information.

5. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.

6. When practising Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning.

7. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. Excuse me
   C. Good night only
   D. Good morning / hello

8. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. chaise
   B. fenêtre
   C. livre
   D. porte

9. When practising Interactive speaking Vocabulary Turn taking Intonation Nonverbal communication, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive speaking Vocabulary Turn taking Intonation Nonverbal communication.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive speaking Vocabulary Turn taking Intonation Nonverbal communication.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive speaking Vocabulary Turn taking Intonation Nonverbal communication.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive speaking Vocabulary Turn taking Intonation Nonverbal communication.

10. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.

11. When practising Interactive speaking Turn taking Nonverbal communication Intonation Questioning, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive speaking Turn taking Nonverbal communication Intonation Questioning.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive speaking Turn taking Nonverbal communication Intonation Questioning.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive speaking Turn taking Nonverbal communication Intonation Questioning.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive speaking Turn taking Nonverbal communication Intonation Questioning.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive speaking Turn taking Nonverbal communication Intonation Questioning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for understanding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
